- Laura: if the trace confirms it was returned on your side, please let me know whether we can hold the invoice in a pending state for 24 hours or if we should mark it as unpaid and proceed with standard collections. Also, please confirm whether we can reissue a VAT-separated breakdown on request.

If Cardine is able to send a same-day wire, we'll prioritize cash application on receipt and confirm by email. If the ACH trace turns up the funds, we'll mark the invoice cleared and cancel any further steps. We'll follow up by 3pm PT with an update.
